provenance.rulingQuote: Edmondson’s explanation in his affidavit that his concerns about the top bunk included his previous head injury does not contradict his prior deposition testimony. So, the question becomes whether Edmondson is trying to create a sham fact issue. Defendants never asked Edmondson whether his bad knees and there being no ladder were his only concerns; Defendants asked whether they were Edmonson’s primary concerns.
